audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart shows blanket 'Skill' for levels 1-6 while content layer and packet both give Diana all five early rows; Diana misgendered in 17 fields.

audit.corrected: Sides moved to Diana with grounded whys; pronouns fixed.

audit.why: Spikes (her 3-5 shield trades, 6 delete combo, Ryze first-item survival, two-item kite) match kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly calls Diana's E an 'E pull' — Lunar Rush (E) is her dash; the pull is Moonfall (R). Cooldowns field has no digit and packet flags zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Kit text: E 'dashing to an enemy', no cooldown when dashing to a Moonlight target (22s otherwise); R 'draws in all nearby enemies'. Q 8s, R 100s.
audit.corrected: E-pull references corrected to the dash; cooldowns rewritten with 8s/22s/100s and a wait-for-X line.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Diana Crescent Strike: 8s at rank 1 — Moonlight resets her 22s Lunar Rush, so sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Moonfall is 100s — wait it out before extended fights.

edits.before: Best wave: an EQ-bounced shove that crashes as your warp comes off cooldown — Ryze waves are map plays with a timer attached. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
